title: Premium creator studio and manual-first video factory
description: Complete the repository-wide manual-first YouTube creator workflow: five-phase creator UI, scene prompt studio, deterministic asset intake, FFmpeg build output, optional CapCut handoff, modular renderer boundaries, and an executable fixture.
businessContext: The product must guide a non-technical Vietnamese creator from a brief to a playable MP4. Manual GG Lab image creation and upload is the only mandatory production step; provider setup and CapCut must not block the normal path.
dependencies: runtime output and character consistency V1.1
existing typed preload IPC and SQLite persistence
existing FFmpeg preview and optional CapCut packaging paths
acceptanceCriteria: Home, Projects, Asset Library, and Settings are the only permanent workspace navigation items; project screens expose Brief, Story, Director, Assets, and Build phases.
The default Vietnamese creator path can create a semi-automatic manual-first project without image-model certification, image credentials, generation queue, or CapCut configuration.
Director exposes approved scene cards, storyboard frames, and exactly one copyable GG Lab scene prompt per scene with frame references, locks, deltas, filenames, and QA checklist.

Asset Intake supports multi-file drag/drop, numeric mapping, manual assignment, replacement, duplicate warnings, missing-frame detection, and blocks Build until every required non-REUSE frame is approved.
Editing or replacing one frame preserves unrelated scene assets and invalidates only affected downstream render and QA artifacts.

FFmpeg renders a deterministic playable MP4 with approved visuals, motion, exact timing, subtitles, voice, and optional supplied music/SFX; FFprobe validates resolution, duration, video, audio, H.264, and yuv420p compatibility.
CapCut remains optional and receives a new render-safe draft only after validated media exists; it never blocks MP4 export.

The renderer is split into route/feature modules with no duplicated business logic, typed preload-only IPC access, centralized Vietnamese labels, visible focus states, and reduced-motion-safe GSAP transitions.

A deterministic fixture covers one project, three scenes, ten storyboard frames, a recurring character, expression/pose changes, a cutaway, a reused frame, voice, subtitles, optional audio, and a real FFmpeg/FFprobe output.
Legacy projects continue to load and retain their existing provider-based visual pipeline.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/media/test apps/desktop/src/main apps/desktop/src/renderer
humanEscalationConditions: A required external provider, secret, paid call, or manual visual approval cannot be replaced by a deterministic local verification.
A safe change requires modifying forbidden provider or Python bridge code beyond the current CapCut adapter contract.
The baseline fails in an unrelated area and cannot be isolated after two targeted attempts.
A migration would risk existing saved project data or user-uploaded files.
